verdict.rationale: `bun install` is the single bootstrap command. It installs all `dependencies`, `devDependencies`, `optionalDependencies` and `peerDependencies` declared in package.json [bun-docs-56], covers workspaces in monorepos [bun-docs-36], reproduces exact versions with `--frozen-lockfile` [bun-docs-35], and auto-migrates npm/yarn/pnpm lockfiles on a fresh clone [bun-docs-52]. Dependency lifecycle scripts like postinstall do not run unless the package is listed in `trustedDependencies` [bun-docs-19][bun-docs-4], and one community report notes install crashes on Windows that required deleting lockfiles and node_modules [bun-comm-13]. Missing for 10: dependency lifecycle scripts running by default without trustedDependencies setup, independent hands-on corroboration of clean fresh-clone bootstrap across platforms.
